scope: one-key future diagnostic launch only; U13 gates unchanged
base: U10.1T8 or newly signed unified base; verify identity first
minimal_change: explicit per-key ability-start fallback after bounded exact desktop search fails
implementation_status: proposal only; no runner/installer/runtime/plan gate modified

trigger.exact_error: exact desktop icon absent across searched pages

record_fields.fallback_reason: recorded exact icon missing; package/ability independently pinned

capture.clock_origin: actual successful aa start return; record timestamp

guards: board whitelist+lock, 318/dual fingerprints before/after, cold_stop, preflight, frozen checks and U13 admission/smoke gates unchanged
acceptance: successful ability launch with attributed bind/process evidence and snapshot_display screenshots; screenshots go to outer, foreground_unconfirmed never proves lit
failure: aa nonzero is app_failed; no fallback to another label/package; preserve icon failure and all launch outputs
comparison: different launch_method is an explicit variable; do not merge into desktop-only reference without outer review
restoration: no deployment; stop target as normal and verify unchanged base; immediate unlock
